description: How Isoba behaved when run point-in-time over every working day since 1990 (only data published by each day, checked for look-ahead): the Crisis meter in 16 crises (what it showed 3 months before, on the day and at the peak, caught in advance / at the time / late / missed), recession risk before 3 US recessions, market-top risk before 4 S&P 500 tops, false-alarm rates, every year since 1990 (average, maximum, days in alarm, what happened that year) and what it does not catch. Call it before claiming reliability.
name: get_track_record
title: Isoba: tested on history
